title: Best Things To Do in Boone NC This Weekend
excerpt: Memorial Day weekend is just around the corner, and the NC High Country is buzzing with spring energy — here's what's happening in Boone and the surrounding area this weekend. Whether you're visiting for the first time or scouting mountain property NC has to offer, Andrew Plyler has you covered.
